Case ID: 1109
Case Type: IT Ticket
Date: 2025-03-27
Handled By: IT - Hannah Doyle
Customer or Requestor: Internal Team - Returns Queue
Title: Shared inbox permission removed during directory sync

Issue Description
The Returns team reported that three agents lost access to a shared mailbox used for high-priority refund escalations after a scheduled directory synchronization.

Steps Taken
- Checked recent identity sync changes and found a group nesting update applied the previous evening.
- Confirmed the affected users were still in the correct department and role assignments.
- Restored mailbox permissions through the admin console and tested access with one of the impacted users.
- Reviewed whether any messages were missed during the outage window and notified Operations leadership.

Resolution
Reinstated access for all affected users within the hour and confirmed no escalation emails were permanently lost.

Follow-Up
IT created a change review item for nested group updates affecting operational mailboxes.

Reference Documents
- IT Ticket Resolution Guide v2
- Access Control Runbook v2
